name: UpdateAllEmailProperties
description: Updates properties of a specific Outlook email using Microsoft Graph, such as read status, flag, categories, and importance.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select Microsoft 365 credentials to authenticate the request.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox containing the email to update

fields.name: MessageId
fields.label: Message ID
fields.description: The unique identifier of the email message to update.

fields.name: IsRead
fields.label: Read Status
fields.description: Set the email's read status. 'true' marks it as read, while 'false' marks it as unread.

fields.name: FlagStatus
fields.label: Flag
fields.description: Set the email's flag status. Use 'notFlagged', 'flagged', or 'complete' to indicate the desired flag state.

fields.name: Categories
fields.label: Categories
fields.description: A list of categories to assign to the email. Categories are user-defined labels that can help organize and classify emails. Provide an array of category names as strings.

fields.name: Importance
fields.label: Importance
fields.description: Set the email's importance level. Choose from 'Low', 'Normal', or 'High' to indicate the priority of the email.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the email update operation, including success status and any error messages.
